south-pole.focus: Persistent power, water-ice access and the primary crewed hub of the south polar programme.
highlights: Near-continuous sunlight on the rim supports solar-first power.
Adjacent permanently shadowed craters hold the main water-ice resource.
Anchor demand from crewed Artemis surface stays.
